# Deskwisp

> Deskwisp is a Windows app that gives a small business a team of AI agents (AI employees) for its back office. Each agent works on its own cloud computer, can have its own work email address and a voice, remembers the business, and handles tasks such as email, invoices and payment reminders, lead follow-ups, keeping sheets and CRMs up to date, research and reports. You chat with the agents or call them, and they ask before they send, buy or delete anything.

## Key facts

- Platform: Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). Agents can also be reached on iMessage and by text (SMS), in Telegram, Discord, Slack and by email.
- Each agent has: a cloud computer with up to 4 screens (watch it live or take over), a work email address (Pro and Max), a voice you can call from the app, and a memory of your business. It can also have a US or Canadian phone number for texts and calls, on the user's own AgentPhone account (the user pays AgentPhone for it), and the team's number can be an iMessage line from that account.
- Safety: looking things up happens straight away; sending, creating, buying and deleting wait for the user's approval.
- AI agent vs AI chatbot: a chatbot answers in a chat window and leaves the work to you; a Deskwisp agent does the task on its own computer, works alongside other agents, and remembers your customers and prices.

## Plans

- Free: $0. $1 of AI credit and 10 computer hours a month, 1 screen per bot, as many bots as you like.
- Pro: $29 a month. $10 of AI credit, 60 computer hours a month, 2 screens per bot, an email address for the main bot, share with 2 people.
- Max: $199 a month. $100 of AI credit, 300 computer hours a month, 4 screens per bot, up to 5 email addresses, share with up to 5 people.
